Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services

assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

Note: Commission agendas and minutes are available from the Staff Liaison or at the office of the City Clerk, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
